article_manifest.summary: The Malian army claims to have intercepted a consignment of 2,000 portable radios north of Timbuktu, in northern Mali, on Monday 9 November 2026. article_manifest.title: Burkina Faso issues arrest warrants for around 20 people, including journalists
article_manifest.original_title: Burkina Faso issues arrest warrants for around 20 people, including journalists
article_manifest.summary: Burkina Faso on Friday issued arrest warrants and extradition requests for around 20 people including exiled journalists, activists, an ex-minister, and former military officers. They are accused of several terrorism-related charges including complicity in terrorist activities, financing of terrorism, and the “glorification of terrorism”. Alleged acts of defamation, undermining the morale of the National Armed Forces and contempt of public authority, are also reportedly mentioned.

article_manifest.title: Cooperation between Mali and Türkiye: a strategic partnership to strengthen security
article_manifest.original_title: Coopération Mali Türkiye : un partenariat stratégique au service du renforcement de la sécurité
article_manifest.summary: Cette rencontre, tenue en marge du Salon international de la Défense et de la Sécurité (BAMEX 26), s'inscrit dans le cadre du renforcement des relations de coopération entre le Mali et la Türkiye, particulièrement dans le domaine de la sécurité. Au cours des échanges, les deux parties ont réaffirmé leur volonté commune de consolider ce partenariat, notamment à travers la formation, le partage d'expériences et le renforcement des capacités opérationnelles des Forces Armées et de Sécurité.

article_manifest.title: Defence: Diversify to gain autonomy
article_manifest.original_title: Défense : Diversifier pour gagner en autonomie
article_manifest.summary: Mali is continuing to expand its military partnerships, as further illustrated by the holding of BAMEX 2026. This diversification is also accompanied by ambitions in terms of training, technology transfer and the development of a national defence industry. .
